title: A licensee may not in any way aid or abet the unlawful practice of pharmacy
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(10), a licensee may not in any way aid or abet the unlawful practice of pharmacy.
exam_relevance: Tests the prohibition on aiding or abetting, in any way, the unlawful practice of pharmacy.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: 247 CMR 9.01(10) does not define the unlawful practice of pharmacy.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
